answer: One concrete Sybil defense is stake-and-grade anchoring: each identity must lock earned POA as an anchor before its votes or attestations carry weight. Peer juries act as a falcon, rapidly spotting duplicated or low-effort answers and slashing the bond. High-quality original work is the scarce nectar that builds lasting standing. An attacker scaling fake accounts faces rising marginal cost because every new identity needs its own independent high-grade history and fresh stake that cannot be shared or bulk-produced without detection.
